AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#658 @ 4de7a6dccaabd8ead5aabbfa276ebcf847a114c0 — VERDICT: APPROVE

AUD-SOL-INV3-121, agent 121. Independent T4 FIX ROUND 1 review; **A/B/C = 0/0/4** (four carried, optional follow-ups). No other lens's current-round notes or verdict were read before this verdict. [Candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658)

### Prior own findings: closed

- **B-658-1 closed:** `coach-code-tools.service.ts:192–207,254–265,307–317,430–431,547–549,714–716,827–845` resolves the legacy active-team attribution, writes head tenant plus issuer, filters reads/counts/mutations to the issuer for a sub-coach, gives the head all team codes, and denies the sub-coach's team-link rotation before writing; row rotation preserves head and issuer. The committed unit probe checks head/sub/other-sub visibility and mutation denial; the real-PostgreSQL case verifies actual attach to the head and head-ledger counting. [Builder's exact fix and tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658#issuecomment-5999613642)
- **B-658-6 closed:** `coach-code-tools.service.ts:289–325` awaits the shared package decision before publishing any row, then writes `package_id` and `grant_mode` in the same INSERT; both same-key replay paths read that complete row, and the old post-publication delete-on-refusal path is gone. `invite-grant.service.ts:286–308,330–335` preserves the existing package-owner/activity/agreement checks in the extracted helper. The staged refusal and overlapping-success tests cover the original observer race. [Before-fix six-failure lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37346038154)
- **B-658-7 closed:** `coach-code-tools.controller.ts:99–104`, DTO `:82–90`, tools service `:392–427`, canonical service `:634–698`, schema `InviteCode.successor_code` and this PR's migration now carry the expected old generation through to a persisted first successor. A mismatch does no write, validates ownership of the archived expected code and returns that generation's successor; a retry never advances the current link or changes the grace deadline. Unit tests cover sequential, intentional second, late and missing-expected requests; the real-PostgreSQL probe covers overlapping duplicates plus a grace-zero retry of a grace-24 rotation. [Exact-head migration-backed live job, 109/109 tests across eleven suites](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37346998691/job/111887964538)
- **C-658-2 closed:** `account-deletion.manifest.ts:295–297` deletes ledger rows for both User relations before InviteCode handling; the coverage and FK-order suites are included in the independent replay. [Before-fix manifest lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37348156524)
- Malformed-key handling on the same create lines is also closed; the issuer prefix prevents one team member's idempotency key replaying another's code. [Committed fix-round evidence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658#issuecomment-5999613642)

### Independent evidence and scope

Read every fix-round source/migration/test hunk and the canonical attach, module wiring and tenant helpers; the merge commit's tree is exactly Git's conflict-free automatic merge of prior head `08534e17` and main `ee55f814` (both trees `98bc10f1377cab780331b01cd21577bb94589350`), so it contains no hidden conflict-resolution edits. This is a fix-round review against this model's prior REQUEST CHANGES, not split-piece reuse of an APPROVE; all fixes were independently re-read against the original counterexamples. [Prior own review](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658#issuecomment-5964522757)

Independent exact-candidate supplemental replay lane: **queued at 12:44 PDT**, across the code-tools service/controller, attach-ledger, invite-grant, manifest-coverage and FK-order specs; no unexecuted replay is represented as passed. The verdict rests on independently verified fix code, the original failing-before evidence, and the green exact-head full-suite and migration-backed live jobs, not the queued supplemental lane. [Sol replay lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37364946288)

Size is **2,960/3,000**, grandfathered; all eleven required candidate checks are green, including community-live-tests, schema parity, build-and-test and RLS checks. No local npm/Jest/tsc/eslint/build, candidate-source edit, production action, merge or deploy. [Candidate checks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658/checks)

### Follow-ups (C), non-blocking under FREEZE

- **C-658-3:** `invite-codes.service.ts:422–426` still lists archived “Previous coach link” rows through the legacy endpoint; exclude successor-marked rows there or expose their archived kind. [Builder's carried follow-ups](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658#issuecomment-5999613642)
- **C-658-4:** `coach-code-tools.service.ts:469–470` still copies a package binding on row rotation without rechecking its availability; apply the shared bindability rule and refuse/drop a stale binding. [Builder's carried follow-ups](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658#issuecomment-5999613642)
- **C-658-5 (owner-profile remainder):** `coach-code-tools.service.ts:196–198` still creates/reads a coach profile for a non-sub-coach owner caller; skip the permanent link row for owners. [Builder's carried follow-ups](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658#issuecomment-5999613642)
- **C-658-8:** `coach-code-tools.service.ts:164–169,600–605,673` still derives the leak baseline from the requested display window; `days=1` flags three signups even after a busy week, whereas `days=8` does not. Fetch seven prior local days independently of display `days` and test signal invariance. [Prior own finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658#issuecomment-5964522757)

Composition reminder, not a finding against this head: the accepted #657/#658 second-landing rule maps `code_revoked`, `code_expired` and `code_exhausted` in `ATTACH_TO_COACHLESS`; mobile callers must send expected_code and the create idempotency key. The four product decisions in this round are already accepted; no new operator decision is requested. [Fix-round composition notes](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658#issuecomment-5999613642)
